properties.name: ManagePackageVersionsCentrally
properties.doc: Versions come from PackageVersion items of Directory.Packages.props; PackageReference has none.

properties.name: CentralPackageTransitivePinningEnabled
properties.doc: A PackageVersion also pins the package when it comes transitively.

properties.name: RestorePackagesWithLockFile
properties.doc: Write packages.lock.json with the resolved versions.

properties.name: RestoreLockedMode
properties.doc: Fail the restore when it would change packages.lock.json: for CI.

properties.name: NuGetLockFilePath
properties.doc: The path of the lock file.

properties.name: RestoreSources
properties.doc: Feeds to restore from instead of the ones of nuget.config.

properties.name: RestoreAdditionalProjectSources
properties.doc: Feeds to restore from besides the ones of nuget.config.

properties.name: RestoreUseStaticGraphEvaluation
properties.doc: Evaluate the projects of a big solution in one pass: a faster restore.

properties.name: NuGetAudit
properties.doc: Check the packages for known vulnerabilities during restore.

properties.name: NuGetAuditMode
properties.doc: Audit the packages the project references itself, or the transitive ones too.

properties.name: NuGetAuditLevel
properties.doc: The lowest severity that is reported.

properties.name: DisableImplicitNuGetFallbackFolder
properties.doc: Do not use the fallback folder of the SDK: every package goes to the global packages folder.

items.name: PackageVersion
items.doc: The version of a package for the whole repository (central package management).

items.name: GlobalPackageReference
items.doc: A package every project gets: analyzers, SourceLink, versioning tools.

metadata.name: IncludeAssets
metadata.doc: What of the package is used.

items.name: PackageDownload
items.doc: Download a package without referencing it; the version is exact: [1.2.3].

items.name: NuGetAuditSuppress
items.doc: An advisory URL the audit does not report.
